purpose: Independent review reproduction of the T42.H2b native sealed-input checks and of the kernel memfd sealing contract they depend on, executed off the T42.H1 selected host

reproduction_environment.vm: colima profile default, vmType vz, aarch64, 2 CPUs, 2 GiB
reproduction_environment.userspace_architecture: amd64 under Rosetta translation on an arm64 kernel
reproduction_environment.test_binary_built_by: GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -c ./spike/t421, on darwin/arm64 with go1.26.5
reproduction_environment.race_build_reason: the race detector requires cgo and a linux/amd64 C cross toolchain, which this host does not provide
reproduction_environment.go_toolchain_failure: cmd/go aborted with 'runtime: marked free object in span ... (bad use of unsafe.Pointer or having race conditions?)' at cmd/go/internal/modindex.getFileInfo while indexing the module cache; an emulation artifact, so only the pre-cross-compiled test binary was executed

kernel_contract_probe.note: Standalone syscall probe, no phebs code, run on the same 6.8.0-117-generic kernel. Verifies the semantics input_custody_linux.go and its tests assume.
kernel_contract_probe.open_o_rdwr_on_write_sealed_memfd: succeeds once the mode is owner-writable
kernel_contract_probe.utimensat_on_fully_sealed_memfd: succeeds, moves Mtim, seal set stays intact at 0x2f, writes still EPERM

flake_diagnosis.status: pre-existing at the reviewed head; not introduced by any correction
flake_diagnosis.failing_assertion: input_custody_linux_test.go:150 'allowed non-execute metadata drift must still invalidate custody'
flake_diagnosis.failing_variant: executable=false (21-byte fixture); executable=true passed, doing more work before the drift
flake_diagnosis.mechanism: the test chmod'ed a sealed memfd to add owner-write and restored the original mode, then required Check to refuse through Ctim; Linux stamps inodes from a coarse clock, so a restore inside one tick changes no compared field and Check correctly accepts
flake_diagnosis.probe_effective_inode_timestamp_granular: ~1 ms (40 distinct Ctim values in 40 ms of continuous chmod)
flake_diagnosis.security_impact: none. The seals deny writes independently of mode, so a same-tick restored chmod gains nothing; metadata comparison is defense in depth, not the load-bearing control.
flake_diagnosis.documentation_impact: the PLAN ADR and operations guide claimed detection of any non-execute permission drift; both now state the same-tick boundary explicitly
flake_diagnosis.recorded_host_explanation: the T42.H1 host passed 20 race repetitions by timing margin, not by guarantee
